speaker: Mr Xie Yao Quan
text: asked the Minister for Education whether the Ministry can provide an update on the actions taken by Montfort Secondary School in response to a recent bullying incident in the school.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Minister Maliki, I hope your answer is about four minutes, because that is all the time we have.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: You have to, because Question Time is 30 minutes.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: And my response will also address the written question filed by Mr Leong Mun Wai, which is scheduled for a subsequent Sitting.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: We all are very concerned about the well-being of our students.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, I invite Members to seek clarifications if needed, if we have time.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: However, most of this work happens behind the scenes in schools, and members of the public may not be aware of the actions taken.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, today, I would like to highlight some additional points to make clear MOE’s approach in handling bullying and fighting incidents.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: However, I would also point out that when any incident of fighting or bullying is shared online, for example, via a social media post or a video, usually a one-sided story is presented, from a particular perspective.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: While we would hope that members of the public can remember that what they see or read online may not present the full facts of the case, people often react emotively to what they see online and form quick judgments on what happened, or who was in the right or wrong in that incident.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: Hence, let me put forth what MOE and schools do when handling such incidents.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: If a Police report is filed, the school will also assist the Police in their investigations, including supporting their staff and students who may be called up for questioning.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: MOE and schools would prefer to handle each case sensitively to provide space and privacy for the students involved to learn from their mistakes and grow from the experience.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: However, if a case is made public online and the information provided is unduly skewed such that it causes public concern, damages the reputation of other parties, and/or seek to promote one’s side of the story even though the accuser may not be totally innocent, MOE may have to put out the facts of the case to provide a balanced view of the entire incident, including the actions of all who were involved, based on the school’s investigations.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: This is to be fair to our educators and all parties involved.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: MOE may also put out information on the actions taken against all parties who share responsibility for the incident – the initiator who started the fight, and others who retaliated or joined in subsequently.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: This is to remind them not to do so, to avoid further hurting the ones who are involved and to highlight to them that by sharing the recordings, they are endorsing the acts and are complicit to the act.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: This will also mitigate the impulse to normalise or chase the extremes in the contest to circulate ever more startling videos and content.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: While firm actions will be taken to address the parties involved in each incident, the school will also use the opportunity as a teaching moment for all its students.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: We cannot form good conclusions from a video snippet.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, I thank you for your concern for our students.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: Let us work together to protect schools as a safe space for our children to learn from their mistakes to change and to grow.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
